title: National Commission
description: Definition of National Commission under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019

content.legal_definition: the National Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission established under sub-section (1) of section 53
content.plain_language: a national level commission that helps resolve consumer disputes
examples: A consumer files a complaint with the National Commission about a defective product
The National Commission hears a case about a company's unfair trade practice
non_examples: A private company's customer service department

user_queries: What is the National Commission for consumers?
How do I file a complaint with the National Commission?
What is the role of the National Commission in consumer protection?
